domains.name: Authentication — MFA, passkeys, OTP & password policy
Storefront UI kit, design tokens, a11y & i18n (Bridge)
Platform, MCP & back office (no storefront wave)

exploratoryCharters.mission: Discover what breaks when the sprint's cart/address changes meet in one buyer session, and whether address autocomplete, maps and push registration still work after the Google Cloud account move (GAP-31, no suite); suites 028/081/011 assert each change alone.
candidateScenarios: A long Line1/Line2 address saved in the ship-to popup, then shown in checkout and an order, at desktop and 375 px (GAP-20, GAP-21)
A promo line with "Round amount per item" unchecked: price per item across the narrow breakpoint while the checkbox names are read by a screen reader (GAP-22, GAP-23)
Anonymous cart then sign-in merge, then address autocomplete and map on a new address (GAP-24, GAP-31)

exploratoryCharters.domain: Authentication — MFA, passkeys, OTP & password policy
exploratoryCharters.mission: Discover seams between MFA per-store policy and the three sign-in methods (password, OTP, passkey) with an expired password, a forced change and an org fallback; suites 104/111/114/114a/114b each hold one method and no policy permutation.
candidateScenarios: Policy changed by an org maintainer while a member is on the code step (GAP-01, GAP-02)
Expired-password account through OTP, passkey and password with MFA on and off, ending on the right page each time (GAP-03, GAP-04)
Passkey add/delete on the Security page by keyboard only, then sign-out and sign-in in a second tab (GAP-05)

exploratoryCharters.domain: Storefront UI kit, design tokens, a11y & i18n (Bridge)
exploratoryCharters.mission: Discover pages where the token, soft VcWidget, CSS-layer and form-a11y changes interact: a preset, a widget mode and a long locale together; 048c/070/071 check layout per feature, not their combination.
candidateScenarios: Each preset (incl. Watermelon) x classic/soft widget on PDP, cart, account dashboard: radius, focus ring vs error colour, overflow (GAP-08, GAP-09, GAP-10)
Required and invalid fields under pl/ru with a keyboard-only walk: label size/colour parity and announced error state (GAP-07, GAP-11)
Header badge at large counts in pl/pt/es/ru at 1024 and 375 px with the soft design (GAP-12)

exploratoryCharters.mission: Discover seams in the Sales Rep Hub after two stories, a header link, a report component and six layout fixes landed together: the Tasks customer filter, coupons widget, customer-profile report and dashboard layout share one rep session.
candidateScenarios: Rep opens the hub from the new header icon, filters Tasks by customer, schedules a call, then opens that customer's profile report and coupons at 768 and 320 px (GAP-13, GAP-14, GAP-16, GAP-17)
Edit layout hides every block, reload, language switch, then the Customers/Status/Priorities row is checked for raw keys (GAP-18)
A rep who loses a served customer mid-session: Tasks, coupons and report on the same page (GAP-13, GAP-15, GAP-16)

exploratoryCharters.mission: Probe the P0 browse path (I=5) where several navigation-race and focus fixes landed with a low likelihood score and no combined test: category load race, search scope chip, compare freeze, GA payload.
candidateScenarios: Click through three categories quickly and use Back while the first loads; URL vs page on screen (GAP-25)
Add a scope chip, remove it by keyboard, search with an apostrophe in the term, compare 4 products and resize (GAP-25, GAP-26, GAP-28)
Same session: GA view_item_list on /search and category pages after each step (GAP-27)
